nom: COSRX Advanced The Vitamin C 23 Serum with Super Vitamin E & Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: If you use it on its own it will feel little little niddles poking however you can mix it with moisturizer to help with that
I am using this product since 2024, the results are always amazing. I would recommend this product for dark acne marks.

I bought their Vit C serum in the past and had a great experience, so im thinking this may be a malfuction with this specific bottle. I have only used this twice as i bought it 2 days ago… and its turning my face orange :/ like a streaky orange tanning lotion orange. Its not good, and the smell is strange enough that my husband mentioned its smell on my face after it being on all day since morning.

avis.titre: I would by this product again
avis.texte: The product works extremely well. I noticed the improvements on my face, a firm look and a glow on the skin, and a soft feel
This is gentle on your skin and works well, a true Vitamin C serum.
I've just started using the serum and I'm really into the texture. I'm definitely going to stick with this product because I love the COSRX line.

After pregnancy and post-partum wrecked my skin, I needed something to help with dark spots, redness, rough texture, and dullness. I was using a different vit C serum that didn't seem to help. Three days of using this and my skin already started looking amazing! Discoloration is improved and my skin feels and looks incredibly smooth and bouncy. It did tingle slightly the first few uses, so it may be too strong for sensitive skin. Keep it in the fridge.

love this COSRX vitamin C i keep it in the fridge it nice and cool and absorbs well in the skin. I use to use that fancy french one that starts with a V it would turn orange and tint my skin orange. i love the Korean skin care lines beats the french skin care lines i have used in the past

Been using this product for two weeks and it's amazing! It minimized my fine lines, made my skin more luminous and made these irritating bumps on my jaw line completely disappear! So relieved I ordered a back up bottle! 😅

I knew I had some discoloration on my face and my skin felt dull, but hot dog I didn't realize how much so until I started to use this product and saw such a difference! I have dark purple circles around my eyes and nose and just a few drops at the top of my cheeks, under my eyebrows (don't want to get too close to my eyes), and around my nose have changed the game!! The texture of my skin has improved, there's so much less dicoloration, and my fine lines are softening. This truly was the step I was missing from my beauty routine! I can't recommend it enough, especially for the price.
Purchased this on the Ulta beauty sale i really like it i have in my fridge i use it at night feels good on the skin and absorbs. i liked it so much i purchased a second bottle

The smell is horrible and it oxidized really quick. Also, the bottle is only half full. I finished the first bottle within 1 month, which is odd for me because it usually takes me close to 3 months to finish a 1 oz bottle. So I checked the second bottle I ordered and it was only half full. I won't be ordering this product again.

I generally like COSRX products, however this product is not my favorite. Initially, when I opened the product, it sounded like opening a can of soda. I wasn't sure if that's the way the product is supposed to sound upon initial opening so I used it but my face does not love it. I'm thinking maybe I got a bad batch. I'll be returning this product and selecting something different moving forward. ￼

Smoothing, hydrating, effective. A little goes a long way. Was using paulas choice vitamin c but now switched to this. Better value and more effective. Love this brand- everything except that snail mucin stuff.
It made my face very sticky, I haven't seen a difference in appearance

avis.titre: I like how this makes my skin feel. But it burns.
avis.texte: Like the product. But it burns my skin for some reason. I have not used it much because of the burning.
I did not enjoy this product. It burned my skin after I applied it. Returned item for a refund.

I don't understand how this product gets such good reviews. It smells horrific. Maybe I just got a bad bottle, but I did not realize how bad it was until a couple times into use and now it's too late to return. It's really gross.

avis.titre: My face feels and looks smooth
avis.texte: I really like this serum. It feels smooth going on, and my skin looks good with use. It glides well with foundation. The main thing is that it's expensive for only 0.7 ounces, and comes in a 2 ounce bottle! It's misleading, and I'll only buy it when it's half price.

avis.titre: oh so how long yal been keeping this secret
avis.texte: This product fits perfectly into the routine and the results are NOTICEABLE. Works great with glycolic acid, absorbs enough to go under makeup, and actually makes the skin look radiant on no makeup days. COSRX what are ya doing to me? lol
Excellent serum! Goes on soft and doesn't stay greasy. Gives me skin the soft glow it needs.
This a great serum it blends into the skin very well. Does not feel heavy
great ingredients and seen some tests online that shows its effectiveness
Love this serum so much! I've been using it for a few months and have definitely seen improvements in my skin tone
my skin looks so great. the effect is amazing and it doesn't feel too heavy on my skin.

I decided to use Advanced The Vitamin C23 Serum every other day to go easy on my skin in case there was any sensitivity. (I already have and use a daily and nightly regimen of COSRX products) So, I have only used Advanced The Vitamin C23 Serum 4 times in 8 days,and WOW WOW WOW! It works beautifly, I have a dark brown 'age spot' on my cheek that came with the beauty of pregnancy, and I kid you not, this spot has almost completely faded away in just 4 applications! Also, my husband said to me last night, "I can tell the new stuff is really working, already, your skin (texture and glow) looks like a teenager's" So yes, it really really works and is very gentle on my skin, no irritation at all. In fact very calming and soothing on my skin with every other day use. I love this product! Perfect formula, please don't ever change it.
Been using this for years and will never not use it. It fades my dark spots so quickly and keeps my skin glowing.
COSRX Advanced The Vitamin C 23 Serum has brightened and protected my skin from aging and I love using it for the last 3 years.
I love using this serum every morning. It's not sticky or anything and it feels good on the skin. Just make sure that you use sunscreen if you're using this every morning
So far I am liking this product. Not seeing any big changes but I am still new to using it. It isn't breaking me out which is nice because I have sensitive skin that reacts to many products.

avis.titre: visible brightness and smoother skin texture
avis.texte: I love the COSRX Vitamin C 23 Serum! It made my skin brighter and smoother in just a few weeks. It's strong but gentle, and I can see my dark spots fading!
My skin loves this product. Light, easy to apply and wonderful results. My total skin care routine is ALL Cosrx
This was the 1st product I tried from COSRX! So happy. As my skin ages, I'm super grateful to find such a high quality product that doesn't break the bank! Love your samples too!
Love it. I have purchased this 3x now. Makes my skin glow and look youthful. I pair it with the skin barrier serum every day

Undoubtedly it's the best product for all skin types and also for the uneven skin tone. I've been using this product for quite sometime in combination with All in one snail serum, it's usually helps me to get back my glow eventually . But the product is not delivered with care and so I've received a damaged package. Team needs to focus on delivering the product with uttermost care.

Excellent product. Helped to brighten and even my East Asian complexion which had been dull with slightly darker discolored patches due to long term sun neglect. Did so within 3, 4 weeks when applied alone once daily on cleansed skin without applying moisturiser or other skincare product at the same time. I call my sundown routine as I apply it alone after cleansing my face when the sun sets to remove the sunscreen I have been wearing during daytime. One suggestion of improvement is that the current dropper is not long enough to reach the bottom of the bottle. As a result, there is always a fair amount of serum wasted because I can't reach it by using the dropper.

avis.titre: Shocked by what a difference it makes
avis.texte: I am SHOCKED by the difference this product makes. When I bought it I wasn't sure if Vit C was really necessary for my skin care routine, and felt silly for buying another product. But I could see the difference after 2 days. My skin looks noticeably tighter and brighter and firmer. I've never used a product with such drastic results. I do not have sensitive skin so went for the 23 and have no regrets. My only problem with it is it says it's supposed to be refrigerated, which is a little inconvenient. Small price to pay. Amazing product.
great price, works great , have seen immediate results, skin feels and looks smoother
I like it. Only been using a week or so. It says store in the fridge. Great addition to my skin care regimen.
Amazing product!!!! So far I've been impressed with all the Cosrx products I'm using.
I have always used vitamin c for almost 2 year s so I like this product
My skin tone is even and I have less hyperpigmentation. It also leaves my skin feeling hydrated and healthy.
I love it, it provides brightness and an espectacular glow in my skin.
Provides great hyrdation for my skin and my skin is usually pretty dry. Also works well at keep my skin moisturized underneath my makeup.

Just added this to my routine and it's Amazing ! Feels great on my skin and my skin looks much brighter in just 1 week :u1F973: I break out easily when trying new products but vitamin c 23 serum was a great add on!
Best of all, I love it and will keep using it, I love my looks now, no regret on this product 😍
